item.title: GovBrief Today #605
item.description: The White House spent $319,000 of your money to run one of Donald Trump's 2024 campaign ads during Sunday's NFL games. The 30-second spot is nearly identical to the one his campaign aired two years ago, black and white, Trump walking down a hallway while his voice promises a "final battle" against "globalists" and "warmongers." The campaign version ended by asking viewers to join his fight. This one ends with "Paid for by the U.S. Government." It is the third ad since Wednesday, and the White House calls all of them public service announcements. Election Day is 37 days out. Before You Vote went live tonight at govbrief.today/vote, 50 pages, one for each state, a year of stories sorted by where you live with the links to check your registration at the top. Nobody narrates it, and nobody paid for it but me. I've emailed 9,265 stories over 605 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will.
